title: Find Champion I
sourceKind: secondary mirror (leetcode.doocs.org/en/lc/2923); official page not retrievable
summary: In an n x n strength grid (grid[i][j] = 1 means team i beats team j), return the team that beats every other team.
officialConstraints: n == grid.length == grid[i].length; 2 <= n <= 100; entries 0 or 1; diagonal 0; exactly one of grid[i][j], grid[j][i] is 1 for i != j; transitive.
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps the grid at 10 teams. Difficulty tag not taken from a source.
